text:
alex.support: Customer report (case 209321): signup completed but welcome trial credits not granted. Customer email org_user@example-corp.com, account acct_01G8X, region DE. They used company SSO + phone OTP during signup and added a corporate Visa. No charges, but welcome_credits not present. Can someone check gating?

sam-billing: On it. Do you have the signup event log / payment check details?

alex.support: paste event stream: `signup -> sso_connected -> email_verified -> phone_otp_verified -> payment_method_attached (pm_1Lk) -> payment_check: BIN=US, card_country=US, account_region=DE -> auto_gate=manual_review (payment_bin_mismatch)` . Promo tag on account: `welcome_100_free`. No stripe charge id (no 3DS).

maria-ops: @sam-billing policy note: we don't auto-grant when payment method triggers manual_review. That said, manual grants are allowed after triage if the account looks clean. Pinged @jordan-pm for product confirmation on corporate SSO exemptions. :eyes:

jordan-pm: Confirming — enterprise-exempt list is only for pre-approved partner domains; example-corp.com not on it. Manual grant is fine if support confirms no abuse signals.

sam-billing: I'll run a quick risk check (IP, past accounts, billing history). If green, I'll issue manual grant. Please confirm last4 and that the customer is okay with manual override.

alex.support: Last4=4242. Customer confirmed they want the credits manually added so they can start testing. No previous accounts found.

sam-billing: executing manual grant now -> `billing-bot: /manual-grant acct_01G8X amount=100 reason="support:manual_grant after gated_payment" executor=sam-billing`

billing-bot: action logged: manual_grant id=mg_0007 acct=acct_01G8X amount=100 executor=sam-billing ts=1718765528

alex.support: Customer reports +100 credits appeared at 1718765530. Thanks everyone — closing the loop. :white_check_mark:

maria-ops: leaving a short note in account audit about BIN mismatch and manual grant. If we see repeated patterns we should tighten gating rules.

sam-billing: noted. If the customer runs into usage/limits, re-open.
